jvm-aot-cache.title: Build the AOT cache in the image and prove it is used

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-aot-cache-1 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. The AOT cache built in the image is usable with the image's GC and class path: -XX:AOTMode=on exits 0. Result: AOTMode=on with the image's GC and class path: exit 0 (openjdk version "25.0.4.1" 2026-08-18 LTS). Limitations: The training run warns that a few Spring ClassFile reader classes cannot be archived; the cache is still used.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-aot-cache-2 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. The unchanged ENTRYPOINT opens the cache: with -Xlog:aot the JVM logs Opened AOT cache /app/app.aot. Result: unchanged ENTRYPOINT with -Xlog:aot logs "Opened AOT cache /app/app.aot.". Limitations: The log text was read from the first run on 25.0.4.1+1 and may change with the JDK.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-aot-cache-3 · measured · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. The AOT cache shortens startup of the stage 1 fixture on two CPUs and 1 GiB. Result: process running for (s), --cpus=2 --memory=1g, 10 alternating rounds. AOT off [4.74 4.72 4.87 4.86 4.67 4.66 4.59 4.62 4.71 4.59] median 4.688; AOT on [2.40 2.62 2.55 2.62 2.60 2.43 2.42 2.50 2.55 2.56] median 2.550; delta 2.137 s (1.84x). Limitations: A one-endpoint service; a real service loads more classes. x64 only; arm64 is not exercised.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1
records.measurement: 20 samples, median per mode, in seconds (Boot's process running for). One discarded warm-up per mode, then 10 rounds alternating -XX:AOTMode=off and the default, --cpus=2 --memory=1g.

jvm-cpu-count.title: Size the JVM for the CPUs it gets

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-cpu-count-1 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. With no CPU limit, -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1 overrides the CPU count the JVM detects. Result: no CPU limit, nproc 2; -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1 reports Effective CPU Count: 1. Limitations: Proves the override only, not the resulting pool sizes.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-cpu-count-2 · not exercised · baseline v0.1-b1. With ActiveProcessorCount set, GC threads, JIT threads, the common pool and the virtual thread scheduler size themselves for the pod. Limitations: Pool sizes per CPU count come from the source guide's measurements.
records.reason: The fixture proves only that the flag overrides the detected count. Thread pool sizes are not measured.

jvm-flag-placement.title: Put image flags in the ENTRYPOINT, sizing in JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-flag-placement-1 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. The image starts with a read-only root filesystem, /tmp as tmpfs, as UID 10001, and with an unreachable OTLP endpoint: /readyz answers 200 within 60 s. Result: read-only root, /tmp tmpfs, UID 10001, unreachable OTLP endpoint: /readyz 200 after 2.9 s. Limitations: Docker flags stand in for the pod security context; no cluster run yet.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-flag-placement-2 · not exercised · baseline v0.1-b1. A Deployment's JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS replaces the image's value instead of merging, so flags placed there disappear. Limitations: Documented Kubernetes and launcher behaviour.
records.reason: Not exercised in a cluster yet. A cluster end-to-end test will cover the Deployment.

jvm-gc-choice.title: Choose G1 unless pauses are what you sell

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-gc-choice-1 · not exercised · baseline v0.1-b1. G1 suits request and response services, generational ZGC sub-millisecond pause targets, and Parallel batch jobs. Limitations: No workload comparison in this repository.
records.reason: Reasoned from the JEPs and the HotSpot GC tuning guide. No collector comparison is run.

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-gc-explicit-1 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. With one CPU and 4 GiB and no GC flag, the JVM picks SerialGC. Result: --cpus=1 --memory=4g, no GC flag: UseSerialGC = true, UseG1GC = false. Limitations: Docker CPU and memory limits on one runner, not a Kubernetes node.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-gc-explicit-2 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. With two CPUs and 1700 MiB and no GC flag, the JVM picks SerialGC. Result: --cpus=2 --memory=1700m, no GC flag: UseSerialGC = true. Limitations: 1700 MiB and 2048 MiB bracket the threshold of about 1792 MiB; they do not locate it.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-gc-explicit-3 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. With two CPUs and 2048 MiB and no GC flag, the JVM picks G1. Result: --cpus=2 --memory=2048m, no GC flag: UseG1GC = true. Limitations: None known.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-gc-explicit-4 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. -XX:+UseG1GC selects G1 in both cases where the JVM would pick SerialGC. Result: -XX:+UseG1GC at 1 CPU / 4 GiB and at 2 CPUs / 1700 MiB: UseG1GC = true. Limitations: None known.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

jvm-heap-sizing.title: Size the heap from the memory limit

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-heap-sizing-1 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. With -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75 and a 1 GiB memory limit, MaxHeapSize is 805306368 bytes, 75% of the limit. Result: --memory=1g -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75: MaxHeapSize = 805306368. Limitations: Flags only. Native memory under load is not measured here.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-heap-sizing-2 · not exercised · baseline v0.1-b1. The remaining 256 MiB of a 1 GiB pod covers metaspace, code cache, thread stacks, GC structures and buffers of a Spring Boot service under load. Limitations: The table's starting points come from the source guide's measurements, not from a run in this repository.
records.reason: Native Memory Tracking under load is not run yet. A cluster load test will measure it.

jvm-startup-options.title: Pick the startup optimisation by workload

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-startup-options-1 · not exercised · baseline v0.1-b1. Native image, CRaC and Spring AOT trade build cost and runtime constraints for startup as the table shows. Limitations: Only the AOT cache is measured in this repository.
records.reason: Comparison from the source guide and upstream documentation. Only the AOT cache is exercised.

jvm-startup-probe.title: Size the startupProbe from measured startup

records.canonical: Evidence ev-jvm-startup-probe-1 · not exercised · baseline v0.1-b1. A startupProbe budget of about three times p99 startup on the smallest node type avoids killing healthy pods. Limitations: Engineering judgment from the source guide.
records.reason: Needs a cluster and the smallest node type. A cluster end-to-end test will measure it.

contents.title: Size the heap from the memory limit
Size the JVM for the CPUs it gets
Choose G1 unless pauses are what you sell
Put image flags in the ENTRYPOINT, sizing in JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS
Build the AOT cache in the image and prove it is used
Pick the startup optimisation by workload
Size the startupProbe from measured startup

checklist.text: Memory request equals memory limit.
MaxRAMPercentage set from the table, InitialRAMPercentage equal to it.
GC flag explicit in the ENTRYPOINT (-XX:+UseG1GC unless ZGC or Parallel is documented).
No CPU limit and ActiveProcessorCount equal to the CPU request rounded up, at least 2; with a CPU limit, no ActiveProcessorCount.
ExitOnOutOfMemoryError set; heap dumps only to a volume larger than the heap.
java.io.tmpdir and ErrorFile point at the writable /tmp volume, with ErrorFile on the ENTRYPOINT.
AOT cache built in the image from the extracted layout, without --launcher, with remote calls disabled in the training run.
CI fails the build if the cache is rejected (-XX:AOTMode=on check).
Flags that affect the cache (GC, compact headers) are identical in training and production.
startupProbe budget about three times measured p99 startup on the smallest node type, measured with the AOT cache.
Confirm the heap percentage with Native Memory Tracking under load after each JDK or Boot upgrade.

obs-actuator.title: Keep Actuator on its own port

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-actuator-1 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. /readyz answers on the main port 8080 with add-additional-paths, while Actuator itself runs on 8081. Result: read-only root, /tmp tmpfs, UID 10001, unreachable OTLP endpoint: /readyz 200 after 2.9 s. Limitations: Checks /readyz on 8080; it does not probe that 8080 refuses /actuator.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-actuator-2 · not exercised · baseline v0.1-b1. No NetworkPolicy rule admits port 8081, so nothing outside the pod reaches Actuator. Limitations: A deployment prerequisite.
records.reason: Needs a cluster with a NetworkPolicy-enforcing CNI. A cluster end-to-end test will cover it.

obs-collector.title: Put a collector between the app and the backends

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-collector-1 · not exercised · baseline v0.1-b1. A collector gateway batches, retries, scrubs PII and fans out without changes to the app. Limitations: Reasoned from the collector documentation and the source guide.
records.reason: No collector gateway in the fixture yet.

obs-correlation.title: Correlate metric, trace, and log with one trace ID

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-correlation-1 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. A latency bucket's exemplar carries the trace_id of a request in it. Result: Prometheus exemplar on http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{service_name="single-hexagonal",uri="/ping"} carries trace_id dacb060a6a8f38cd237077246b34326f. Limitations: Against grafana/otel-lgtm with exemplar storage on.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-correlation-2 · not exercised · baseline v0.1-b1. Grafana data source links take you from exemplar to trace to log lines in two clicks. Limitations: Grafana provisioning is configuration, not code in this repository.
records.reason: Data source links are not provisioned or tested yet.

obs-logs-otlp.title: Install the Logback appender so logs carry the trace

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-logs-otlp-1 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. A log line written while handling a request reaches Loki with that request's trace_id. Result: Loki {service_name="single-hexagonal"} | trace_id="4c689b5e38b84ce5e06410a474ef7c04" returned "ping". Limitations: Against grafana/otel-lgtm.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

obs-metric-shape.title: Shape metrics: seconds, buckets, SLOs, bounded tags

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-metric-shape-1 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. With base-time-unit seconds, the request timer arrives as http_server_requests_seconds_count with service_name and uri labels. Result: Tempo trace 66d1cdc9f1a4801c676305bf245f43e1 has server span "http get /ping" with uri /ping; Prometheus sum(http_server_requests_seconds_count{service_name="single-hexagonal",uri="/ping"}) = 1; Loki {service_name="single-hexagonal"} | trace_id="66d1cdc9f1a4801c676305bf245f43e1" returned "ping"; 4 more sampled parents at probability 0.1, all 5 traces in Tempo. Limitations: Series names in a Prometheus-compatible store; no SLO buckets are configured in the fixture yet.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-metric-shape-2 · not exercised · baseline v0.1-b1. Explicit SLO buckets and bounded tags keep the series count predictable. Limitations: The series count per timer comes from the source guide.
records.reason: The stage 1 fixture defines no SLO buckets and has one route. A later sample service will prove it.

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-otlp-config-1 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. With only OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT set, one request's trace, metric and log reach the backend. Result: Tempo trace 66d1cdc9f1a4801c676305bf245f43e1 has server span "http get /ping" with uri /ping; Prometheus sum(http_server_requests_seconds_count{service_name="single-hexagonal",uri="/ping"}) = 1; Loki {service_name="single-hexagonal"} | trace_id="66d1cdc9f1a4801c676305bf245f43e1" returned "ping"; 4 more sampled parents at probability 0.1, all 5 traces in Tempo. Limitations: Against grafana/otel-lgtm, not a production collector.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

obs-sampling.title: Sample parent-based in the app, tail-sample in the collector

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-sampling-1 · reproduced · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. At sampling probability 0.1, five requests with sampled parents all produce stored traces, so the sampler is parent-based. Result: Tempo trace 66d1cdc9f1a4801c676305bf245f43e1 has server span "http get /ping" with uri /ping; Prometheus sum(http_server_requests_seconds_count{service_name="single-hexagonal",uri="/ping"}) = 1; Loki {service_name="single-hexagonal"} | trace_id="66d1cdc9f1a4801c676305bf245f43e1" returned "ping"; 4 more sampled parents at probability 0.1, all 5 traces in Tempo. Limitations: A ratio-only sampler would pass this with probability 1e-5.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-sampling-2 · not exercised · baseline v0.1-b1. A collector's tail sampling keeps error and slow traces with a baseline of healthy ones. Limitations: The source guide verified a policy against Alloy; this repository has no Alloy pin yet.
records.reason: No collector gateway in the fixture yet. A later fixture with an Alloy pin and a test backend will prove it.

obs-starter-not-agent.title: Use Boot's OpenTelemetry starter, not the agent

records.canonical: Evidence ev-obs-starter-not-agent-1 · compiled · baseline v0.1-b1 · 2026-10-17. The stage 1 build succeeds with spring-boot-starter-opentelemetry and the OpenTelemetry Logback appender, no Java agent, together with Error Prone, NullAway, Spotless, CycloneDX, Spring Modulith and jMolecules. Result: io.pyahu.fixture.hexagonal.ApplicationTest: 1 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. Limitations: Compiling proves the pins work together, not their runtime behaviour; the other cards prove that.
records.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner, Docker, images by digest from baseline v0.1-b1

contents.title: Use Boot's OpenTelemetry starter, not the agent
Install the Logback appender so logs carry the trace
Sample parent-based in the app, tail-sample in the collector
Shape metrics: seconds, buckets, SLOs, bounded tags
Put a collector between the app and the backends
Correlate metric, trace, and log with one trace ID
Keep Actuator on its own port

checklist.text: spring-boot-starter-opentelemetry on the classpath; no -javaagent and no agent injected through JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS.
spring.application.name, service.version and deployment.environment.name set.
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT points at the collector in each environment.
management.tracing.sampling.probability chosen deliberately (1.0 with tail sampling).
management.otlp.metrics.export.base-time-unit is seconds.
Histograms on http.server.requests and http.client.requests; explicit SLO buckets for SLI thresholds.
No unbounded tag values; HTTP clients use URI templates and auto-configured builders only.
Logback OpenTelemetry appender installed, or stdout JSON collected by an agent, not both.
A collector gateway with memory limiter first, Kubernetes metadata, PII transform, tail sampling, batch and retry.
Grafana data sources linked from exemplars to traces, traces to logs and metrics, and logs back to traces.
Actuator on port 8081, exposure limited to health and info (plus prometheus when scraped), health details hidden.
No NetworkPolicy rule admits port 8081.
